articles.title: Petrol, diesel prices largely stable on Tuesday, 17 November: Check how much fuel costs in New Delhi, Mumbai
articles.description: Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged across major Indian cities on November 17, even as the Centre raised diesel and ATF export levies. Union Minister Suresh Gopi said an immediate fuel price cut was not possible, citing losses of ₹42,000 crore incurred by oil companies.

articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 17): Brent crude drops below $92 amid supply surplus hopes. What Goldman Sachs now expects
articles.description: Crude oil price : Oil prices decreased below $92 per barrel while expectations of a supply surplus grow. The International Energy Agency anticipates a surplus in global oil markets by Q4 this year. Goldman Sachs forecasts that a significant oversupply will persist into 2027 despite ongoing geopolitical risks. As production and shipping from the Middle East recover, concerns about tight supply are easing.

articles.title: Oil slips on supply surplus outlook despite Gulf tensions
articles.description: Recently, oil prices have seen a decline due to an increase in supply expectations linked to recovering exports from the Middle East. Even with ongoing shipping and infrastructure attacks, the International Energy Agency predicts a surplus in the market. Analysts note a shift in supply-demand balance, which is exerting downward pressure on prices.

articles.title: Rupee rises 32 paise to close at 93.92 even as dollar hits 52-week high
articles.description: Indian rupee closed at 93.92, gaining strength despite a rising dollar index and geopolitical tensions. Foreign investors continued to buy Indian equities and bonds, supporting the rupee's performance. Brent crude oil prices fell during the day, contributing to favorable market sentiment. The rupee's increase signifies India's appeal as an investment destination during challenging global conditions. Currency fluctuations reflect broader economic trends affecting various Asian currencies amid rising dollar values.
